_attack_note_a14: A14: this arm carries the SAME `identity.purl` as the `miri` arm - pkg:pypi/greet-miri@1.0.0 - and different bytes. A purl identifies a name and a version; two artifacts can share one. Nothing a consumer would compare has moved: same purl, same version, same document names. A consumer that cached a trust determination against the `miri` arm and did not re-derive it on notice of replacement is answering about bytes that are no longer installed (MIRI-CONSUMER-052; Lifecycle and Security Metadata 9.6). The divergence below is deliberately in a document a consumer READS rather than in identity, because identity is exactly what does not change.
